|game_text=Deploy on a site to cancel a Force drain there. [[Skywalkers]] are power +1 here. At end of your turn, place this Effect in Lost Pile. |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Return Of The Jedi (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-86-Return_Of_The_Jedi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-returnofthejedi-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Return Of The Jedi (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-86-Return_Of_The_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on a site to cancel a Force drain there. Skywalkers are power +1 here. At end of your turn, place this Effect in Lost Pile. OR At any time, deploy on Sidious or [Virtual Block 3] Emperor. Opponent's Interrupts with “Emperor” in game text are canceled and Sidious may not place Jedi out of play. [Immune to Control]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Return Of The Jedi (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 16 April 2014, effective immediately: “At end of your turn, place this Effect in Lost Pile” became “At end of your turn If you control this site, place this Effect in Lost Pile” (the comma after “turn” is gone and “If” is capitalized, as posted), and the card became unique (•): “NOTE: it is also unique now”: “Deploy on a site to cancel a Force drain there. Skywalkers are power +1 here. At end of your turn If you control this site, place this Effect in Lost Pile. OR At any time, deploy on Sidious or [Virtual Block 3] Emperor. Opponent's Interrupts with “Emperor” in game text are canceled and Sidious may not place Jedi out of play. [Immune to Control]”<ref name="forum-p877234">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 16 April 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p877234 p877234] (read 9 November 2026)</ref> The post (“The following errata is issued by the Competitive Balance Team, and is effective immediately”) gives the full text; it writes “Emperor” with straight single quotes and the Immune to Control icon as “(Immune to Control.)”, which is notation only. The original printing has no uniqueness dot.
